hook: Twenty-two organizations hit in a single intrusion campaign

beats.say: GreyNoise tracked an intrusion campaign against Check Point security management servers, with confirmed attacks between October 17th and November 2nd hitting at least 22 organizations.
The actor used 99 IP addresses, mostly disposable infrastructure, for scanning, exploitation and post-exploitation inside the victims' networks.
Victims span finance, energy, government and manufacturing, and GreyNoise has not attributed the activity to any known threat group.
